post.summary: Preview one entity's Anomaly Score under a saved or unsaved model, writing nothing
post.description: ANOMALY-DETECTION-1 S4. Gated on canWorkIncidents; unsaved content also needs canAuthorWorkbench. Body: exactly one of model (a saved id) or content (an anomaly-model), plus entityKey (1-256 chars) and optional asOf (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC; the day before it is scored, default today). Every feature is narrowed to the entity by a bound filter; evaluation is bounded (one entity, a 10 s / 512 MB sandbox). No scores Dataset, Signal or watch-list entry is written. The entity key is masked unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {model, entityType, entityKey, keyMasked, found, periodStart, score, band, raw, elevatedThreshold, highThreshold, insufficientCount, saved, features[{feature, label, bucket, observed, baseline{kind, median, mad, points, season}, unit, zSelf, deviation, direction, weight, contribution, share, insufficient, reason}]}

400.description: Not exactly one of model/content, a missing or over-long entityKey, or a bad asOf.

403.description: The caller lacks canWorkIncidents, or canAuthorWorkbench for unsaved content, or previews content outside its data scopes.

404.description: The saved model is unknown, unparseable or outside the caller's data scopes.

422.description: The content fails the save-time checks, or a feature query fails.

503.description: No Space write or data root.

get.summary: The latest Anomaly Score of one entity under a saved anomaly-model, with its explanation and recent runs
get.description: ANOMALY-DETECTION-1 S4. Gated on canWorkIncidents. An unknown model, a model outside the caller's data scopes, a row the policy engine denies, or no score for the entity are all 404 (existence-hiding). score = 100 x (1 - exp(-raw / scale)) over the weighted RMS of per-feature robust z (D-AD6); every score is recomputable from its features. history lists the last 30 runs, newest first. The entity key is returned as the Space masked: token (keyMasked: true) unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {model, entityType, entityKey, keyMasked, score, band, raw, elevatedThreshold, highThreshold, periodStart, insufficientCount, modelVersion, runId, scoredAt, features[], history[{periodStart, score, band, runId}]}

404.description: No visible score for that model and entity.
